title: Tattoo Tycoon
provenance: Reported by udance4ever (highball-db#796, 2026-10-29), the Epic copy, Apple M1, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.22, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, D3DMetal with AVX advertised, rated 5 of 5 after 4 minutes: DualSense worked out of the box, quitting the game was awkward. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Reported perfect on an M1 with D3DMetal (Epic). Esc and the controller's Start and Select did not bring up a menu to quit, which looks like the game's own design.

knownIssues.symptom: No menu to quit from with Esc or the controller
knownIssues.cause: most likely the game's own design
knownIssues.fix: quit it with Stop on the strip at the bottom of Highball
